goal: Protect users from wallet corruption and data loss if legacy wallet migration fails mid-process
Ensure failed migrations automatically roll back and restore original files without manual repair
agreement: Strong support for keeping original data intact until migration succeeds and handling rollbacks (ryanofsky)
Open objection: comparing raw filesystem error codes fails on Windows MSVC (ryanofsky)
Open objection: failed database creation skips cleanup and leaves temporary files behind (ryanofsky)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it prevents wallet file corruption and data loss during legacy wallet migration
Master deletes original databases prematurely and can roll stale journals into the new wallet on failure
